newsitem.title: USA: Casino Data Systems sees Q4 net loss.
newsitem.headline: Casino Data Systems sees Q4 net loss.

text.p: Casino Data Systems said on Tuesday it will report a net loss of $3.0 to $5.5 million for the fourth quarter.

A material portion of the estimated loss relates to non-recurring charges which could impact net income from about $1.0 million to $2.7 million or $0.5 to $0.14 a share, a statement released by the company said.
Setting aside the non-recurring charges, net losses generated from operating results are expected to be in the range of $2 to $2.5 million or $0.10 to $0.14 per share.
Although the company has not completed the fourth quarter, it said its financial performance will be well below Wall Street estimates.

Fourth quarter results will be negatively impacted by certain non-recurring events, the company said. These events may include a pre-tax charge of up to $1.6 million related to an account receivable, the company said.
Although full or partial collection of the receivable is possible, the company said a charge will be required if it is determined that full recovery is unlikely.

And as is sometimes encountered with high growth technology companies, the company said an evaluation of its inventory could result in a pre-tax charge of up to $2.5 million primarily related to obsolescence.
